clues.text: She was a servant girl in the house of Mary, the mother of John, also called Mark.
After an angel led Peter out of prison, she came to answer his knock at the outer gate.
Standing at the gate of Mary's house, she knew Peter just by the sound of his voice.
So overjoyed to hear Peter outside the house, she forgot to open the gate for him.
She ran inside to the people gathered in prayer and announced that Peter was standing at the gate.
When she said Peter had come to Mary's house, the people gathered there told her she was out of her mind.
Because she kept insisting Peter was at the gate, the praying group said it must be his angel.
